_note: Declared footprints for building art (F1) — the authority for NEW art. A name maps to its footprint as a bare [w, h] (footRoom 0) or {footprint, footRoom}; e.g. "windmill": {"footprint": [1, 3], "footRoom": 24}. Anything absent here (and from the compiled + sheet manifests) only compiles when its canvas is one of the legacy squares (128/256/384/512²) — otherwise the compiler fails and names this file. Keys starting with _ are notes.
